notes.title: PingPong Kings VR - Beta Update #1.02
notes.content:
Hello. fans!

Our company is engaged in various activities at the same time, and we are receiving feedback on several games, so we appreciate the delay in updating.
However, I am trying to create a pleasant play environment even if it is late.

[h1] 
Updated
[/h1]

[quote] 
[list]
    [*] The table has been resized.

    [*] My voice changed during gameplay.

    [*] Animation motion of AI characters has been modified.

    [*] Fixed hand preview error giving sub help.

[/list]


[/quote]


thank you.

notes.title: Oculus Rift, Windows Mixed Reality compatible update!
notes.content:
Now play with Oculus Rift / Windows Mixed Reality!

Various VR device compatibility has been updated.

notes.title: PingPong Kings VR - Beta Update #1.01
notes.content:
Dear fans

we would like to thank you for the feedback we have gathered from the beta phase.Your feedback has been a great help.

[h1] BUG FIXES [/h1]

Fixed a problem that the frame dropped suddenly when the game was executed. You can play in a slightly more pleasant environment.


Once again - thank you for joining us.
